theorem_title: Degree bound for the field of moduli of a Legendre curve
formal_statement:
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.dmod_le (x : Pt) (h3 : TorsionFinite x.1 3) (h5 : TorsionFinite x.1 5) :
    Module.finrank ℚ ↥(fieldOfModuli (curveOf x h3 h5).F (curveOf x h3 h5).E) ≤ deg x.1 := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $\lambda$ be an algebraic number with $\lambda\ne 0,1$. Let $E_\lambda$ be the Legendre curve with equation $y^2=x(x-1)(x-\lambda)$. Assume that the groups of points of $E_\lambda$ over $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ killed by $3$ and by $5$ are both finite.

Let $F_\lambda$ be the number field generated by $\lambda$, chosen square roots of $-1$, $\lambda$, and $1-\lambda$, and the affine coordinates of the nonidentity points in those two groups. Regard $E_\lambda$ as a curve over $F_\lambda$. Let $M_\lambda=\mathbb Q(j(E_\lambda))$ be its field of moduli inside $F_\lambda$. Let $d_\lambda$ be the degree of the minimal polynomial of $\lambda$ over $\mathbb Q$. Then

$$
[M_\lambda:\mathbb Q]\le d_\lambda.
$$

This inequality supplies the field-of-moduli degree bound for the same curve in the degree-bounded tripod locus.
